sources.title: Occamy-1.0: Open Pareto-frontier 35B Intelligence for Co-work
sources.snippet: Occamy-1.0 is a Qwen3.6-35B-A3B model specialized for persistent, reliable execution across long-horizon co-work tasks.

sources.title: Occamy — Data That Evolves with the Model
sources.snippet: At the core of Occamy is Data RSI, a recursive self-evolution mechanism that connects data construction with model training. The Data Engine composes executable tasks from personas, tools, fixtures, skills, constraints, and graders.
